SELECT p.source_system,p.package_no,sr.contract_no,p.carrier_name,p.express_no,p.receiver_name FROM com_shipment_package p JOIN com_shipment_contract_reference sr ON sr.id=p.shipment_contract_ref_id AND sr.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND sr.deleted=0 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_contract c JOIN com_project_contract_relation cr ON cr.contract_id=c.id AND cr.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cr.deleted=0 WHERE c.id=sr.contract_id AND c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND c.deleted=0 AND cr.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND cr.status='ACTIVE' AND (cr.effective_from IS NULL OR cr.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (cr.effective_to IS NULL OR cr.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
AND (p.source_system=#{ref.sourceSystem} AND p.package_no=#{ref.packageNo} AND CAST(p.source_system AS BINARY)=CAST(#{ref.sourceSystem} AS BINARY) AND CAST(p.package_no AS BINARY)=CAST(#{ref.packageNo} AS BINARY) AND CAST(sr.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(#{ref.contractNo} AS BINARY))
AND 1=0
ORDER BY p.id
